name: DiGiCharat Akiba Touitsu
source:
The sales of the store have shrunk, and manager is hired to restructure and recover from crisis. As he communicates with other stores, he gets to hire cute girls from the nearby stores as staff members.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-december-2000-never7-end-of.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
店铺销售额不断下降，经理受聘负责重组并挽救危机。他在与其他店铺交流时，聘请了附近店铺的可爱女孩们来当员工。
